hardware.variant: One assembled kit with operator-reported CoreBoard V1.2.

inputs.name: Static FFS RAM root with console tools and LVGL

scenario: RAM-boot the standard ESP_MOSAICO_SC101IOT CO5300 framebuffer/genfb path and start LVGL. The row-pair worker programs two-row RASET windows (y..y+1) and sends 1920-byte width-4 pixel transfers. The operator views the interface and moves a finger on the touch panel.
expected: The standard EmberBSD display shows a visible interface and the touch event stream reports changing coordinates.
observed: The operator confirmed a visible EmberBSD interface and changing touch coordinates. The kernel attached espspi0 → spi0 → cofb0 and wsdisplay0; LVGL PID 80 remained alive at capture. COFB reported 962 rows sent and zero transfer errors. The SPI trace showed RASET 0x2b with start row 2/end row 3 followed by a hash-valid 1920-byte width-4 pixel transfer. The latest COFB sample was y478 with rows=2 and 960 nonzero pixels across rows 478–479; the diagnostic raw and wire sample endpoints were 0x1106.
limits: One operator-reported V1.2 sample and one RAM-only boot; this did not write NOR or establish another board revision.
The published row-pair worker corrects the CO5300 even-height RASET requirement: the prior one-row windows were invalid; two-row windows use 1920-byte pixel transfers.
Touch coordinate movement is confirmed; orientation, quantitative calibration accuracy, multitouch and sustained reliability were not measured.
Audio playback and EmberBSD Wi-Fi were not tested. The optional camera support remains identity-only; DVP capture is not implemented.
